question: Related Questions Q. I had seen a dream during ramadhan, between 2:30am-3:30 am. Myself along with my three children(1daughter 2 sons) are in a strange ground and are trying to leave the ground. Many Very scary dogs are not allowing us to leave the ground. Whenever we try to leave, they block our way from all sides. They are not barking, not attacking but are just trying to trap us in the ground. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. 1347 views Q. I had seen a dream some 10 years back.At that time my parents had gone for hajj.I was suffering from maleria with high fever and body pain.My brother, sister and uncle were at home.After dinner we all went to sleep, I was having very high pain in my body & i was not able to sleep. I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. 1782 views Q. I searched for this dream before asking it, but was unable to find it. I saw this dream almost an hour before Fajar Namaz. I saw that My boss from head office comes to our branch office and gives order to move things from branch office to company warehouse in different city and dont even tells me or ask me that these things are required or not, after that he is talking to me in good mood and asking questions about business and while he is asking questions he is rubbing his toes on my face, and I'm replying his questions. later it is Namaz time (Not Fajar) and Me, My boss and his younger brother (he also works in the same company) leaves for Namaz (i dont know what namaz it was) and there are two Masjids, we dont go the near by masjid (that is in fornt of the office) but go to a Masjid that is on the back of the office. We all start making wudu and after that I cant see my boss but only his brother is their with me. at this point I woke up. Please advise what this Dream Means, as I'm facing problems in my office since my boss brother has started working in this company and I really want to switch my company. 1515 views Q. حضرت ، میرے والد ایک غلط انسان ہیں ، وہ میری بہنوں کے ساتھ زنا کرنا چاہتے ہیں، وہ سب شادی شدہ ہیں ، اس حال مجھے کیا کرنا چاہئے؟اگر والد کو گھر سے نکال دوں تو بہنوئیوں کو پتا چل جائے گا تو میری بہنوں کا گھر ٹوٹ جائے گا۔ براہ کرم، مشورہ دیں کہ مجھے کیاکرنا چاہئے؟ 1913 views Q.
